scenarios.title: Successful Login with valid email and password
scenarios.description: Verify that a user can log in successfully with valid email and password.
preconditions: User account exists with a valid email and password in the database.

steps.action: Enter valid email and password in the login form.
steps.expectedResult: Email and password fields are populated.
User is logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

scenarios.title: Failed Login with invalid password
scenarios.description: Verify that login fails when an incorrect password is entered.
preconditions: User account exists with valid email and password in the database.

steps.action: Enter valid email and an incorrect password in the login form.
steps.expectedResult: Email and password fields are populated.
Login fails with an appropriate error message: 'Invalid email or password.'

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Login fails and an error message is displayed.

recommendations: Automate high-priority scenarios to ensure fast regression testing.
Implement monitoring for account lockout and session expiration to detect anomalies.
